svg.title: Uttkarsh Chambiyal — infinite tech stack marquee
svg.desc: Languages: Java, C++, C, JavaScript, HTML, CSS. Design and tools: Figma, Git, GitHub, GitLab, VS Code, Bootstrap, Claude, Codex, IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, DataGrip. Currently learning: React, Node.js, MongoDB, Spring Boot, SwiftUI. Bare monochrome logos move steadily in seamless loops, with eight progressive blur layers along each edge. Movement is 20 percent slower than the original. A stationary layout shows every item when reduced motion is enabled.
